effects.effect: Once on each of your [turns](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), you can use a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver) to change one [condition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition) affecting a creature within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [Dramatic Monologue](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-monologue) ability. Choose one of the following [conditions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition) on the target: [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding), [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened)[, prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone), [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed), or [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted). You change that [condition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition) to another of those [conditions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition), maintaining the duration and origin of the original [condition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition). A target who is no longer prone can stand up.
